prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right one depends on what you need (industry, channels, budget, scale, KPIs). Tell me a bit about your goals and I’ll give a tailored short‑list. To help you decide, here’s a quick way to think about it plus a handful of well‑regarded LA options by specialty.

Quick questions (answer any that matter):
- Goal: brand building, performance (CAC/ROAS), personalization/CRM, creative automation, or R&D/AI models?
- Channels: paid search/ social, programmatic display, email, onsite personalization, chatbots?
- Company size & budget: startup <$50k/mo, midmarket, enterprise?
- Timeline: immediate campaign vs long‑term program/tech build?
- Any industry constraints (healthcare, finance, regulated)?

Agency types and example LA options
- Creative + data-driven AI (best when you need integrated creative + tech): R/GA (LA), Media.Monks (LA).
- Performance marketing with AI/ML optimization (paid media, CRO): Wpromote (El Segundo/LA), Hawke Media (LA).
- Enterprise personalization / CRM / CDP + AI: Epsilon / Publicis (LA presence), Accenture Interactive (LA).
- Technical production, deep data engineering & model builds: Media.Monks, larger consultancies (Accenture).
- AI-first platforms you can pair with agencies: Albert.ai (platform), Persado (AI copy) — often used with agencies.

How to pick
- Ask for case studies with measurable KPIs similar to yours.
- Request team bios to ensure data scientists + engineers will work on your account (not just strategists).
- Get a pilot scope and success metrics (30–90 day test) before committing long term.
- Confirm data ownership, model explainability, and privacy compliance (esp. if regulated data).

If you want, tell me your answers to the quick questions and I’ll build a 3–agency shortlist in LA with reasons and suggested questions to ask each.
